description: For a value that is not in the project, such as a Stripe secret key, a bot token or an AI provider's key: get a link where the user pastes it on an Antideploy page, so it goes straight into the application's encrypted variables and never passes through this conversation. Show the user the `url`, say where they find the value in that provider's dashboard, then poll `list_env` until every name appears, and `redeploy`. Never ask the user to paste a key into the chat. Do not ask for what the platform fills in itself (the database, storage, sign-in and email variables, the application's own address and signing secrets).

names.description: The variable names to collect, such as STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.

name: request_keys
title: Ask the user for keys only they have
